gloss: to be late; to arrive late; to be tardy

definitions.gloss: to be late; to arrive late; to be tardy
definitions.explanation: To arrive after the expected or scheduled time, particularly for school, work, meetings, or appointments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遅刻|ちこく}しないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't be late for class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遅刻|ちこく}してしまった。
examples.english: I ended up being late to the meeting because the train was delayed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{遅刻|ちこく}する。

notes:
Refers specifically to arriving after a set start time, most commonly for school, work, or formal appointments. In Japanese society, punctuality is highly valued, and ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧ carries a stronger sense of social fault than the English word "late."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遅刻|ちこく}する: to be late for school
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遅刻|ちこく}する: to be late for work
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: late arrival notice
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦{常習|じょうしゅう}→常習：28124_joushuu⟧: habitual lateness
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧: barely on time / cutting it close

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: to be late — more general; can describe delays of any kind, not just arriving late to a scheduled event
- ⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to not make it in time — focuses on missing a deadline rather than arriving late to a place
